# OpenSA3 reference material

Upstream: https://github.com/dantarion/opensa3

Verified commit: `ba3e98271da173606ef52fcd61c0ee96ecc9fa25`.

The reference descriptions in `tools/Attributes.txt`, `tools/Events.txt` and
their `tools/ref/` copies match upstream's
`OpenSA3/OpenSALib3/Resources/` files, apart from line-ending normalization.
No content changes were found. See [provenance.json](provenance.json) for paths
and SHA-256 hashes of the upstream bytes.

[LICENSE.txt](LICENSE.txt) is the unmodified upstream license text, which states
that OpenSA3 is available under GPLv3. This material retains its upstream terms.
